ops.title: restack: parse gt's 'due to conflicting untracked changes' decline template
ops.description:
gt 1.8.6 emits a second decline family that ccx does not parse: `Did not restack checked out branch <b> due to conflicting untracked changes.` and `... with changes staged.` — a different prefix and connector from the `Did not restack branch <b> because it is <reason>` family gtSyncSkipped now handles (internal/cli/restack.go). It covers THIS worktree own branch with a dirty tree, which gtRestackPreflight explicitly allows (holder == checkout.Root), so preflight cannot pre-empt it.

Not fixed during the 2026-08-01 gt+jj+worktrees work because it could not be established from the extracted gt string table alone whether this template rides exit 0 or is the `Cannot restack ...` hard-error path already handled by classifyGTRestack. Guessing the template would have been inventing behavior.

Evidence: gt string table extracted from /opt/homebrew/Cellar/graphite/1.8.6/bin/gt.

ops.text: Establish by running gt whether the template rides exit 0 or the hard-error path
If exit 0, gtSyncSkipped parses it and the branch is reported as skipped with its reason
Test pins the behavior and is proven falsifiable
